qa: This effect prevents a card from being affected by effects. For example, your Digimon won't suspend if it's chosen for a "suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon" effect, and its DP won't be reduced by 3000 if it's chosen for a "1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -3000 DP" effect.

text_sections.label: Effect
text_sections.text: {Hand} [Counter] ＜Blast Digivolve＞ (Your Digimon may digivolve into this card without paying the cost.) ＜Raid＞ ＜Reboot＞ ＜Blocker＞ [On Play] [When Digivolving] Delete 1 of your opponent's play cost 7 or lower Digimon or Tamers. [All Turns] While your opponent has a Digimon with 13000 DP or more, your opponent's Digimon's effects don't affect this Digimon, and it gets +3000 DP.

text_sections.label: Special Rule
text_sections.text: ＜Overflow (-4)＞ (As this card moves from the field or under a card to an area other than those, lose 4 memory.)
